prompt: We decided to store visit recordings encrypted in S3 with a separate key per family instead of as database blobs, because keys must be revocable when a sibling leaves. The cost is more code and key-management work. Write this up so the team can find it later.
assertions: Produces a record with context, decision, options considered, and consequences
Lists database blobs as a rejected option with a reason
Lists at least one downside or cost in the consequences
Marks the status as Proposed or asks the user to accept it, rather than marking it Accepted on its own
